proposals.title: Item 6—Shareholder Proposal on the Adoption of a Board Policy that the Chairperson of the Board be an Independent Director
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia and other co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 7—Shareholder Proposal on Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests permitting shareholders to act by written consent with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a fully attended meeting.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 8—Shareholder Proposal to Lower Ownership Threshold for Special Shareholder Meetings to 10%
proposals.topic_summary: Requests lowering the ownership threshold for shareholders to call a special meeting to a combined 10% of outstanding common stock.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal and in favor of Item 5 put forth by the Company
